WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    a.player_id,
    p.death_country,
    SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) as diff_sum
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON a.player_id = p.player_id
  WHERE p.death_country != ''
  GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(diff_sum) as avg_diff
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.diff_sum,
    s1.diff_sum - s2.avg_diff as diff_from_avg
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s1.diff_sum > s2.avg_diff
)
SELECT 
  SUM(diff_sum) as total_sum,
  AVG(diff_from_avg) as avg_diff_from_avg
FROM step3
